creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Main board `high` as RAD-354 (range, streaming stdin, generator fn); GitHub #70; VISION.md Phase 3.

`$` buffers to completion - `core/shell.go` returns after `Wait`. What that forces:

- `kwatch` is a bash file with an embedded Rad script for this reason alone, and says so at `kwatch:5-8`: "Rad can't drive the streaming loop itself... The split is deliberate."
- `star:180-189` builds four `while IFS= read -r line` shell pipelines as strings.
- `mci:61` needs `set -o pipefail; {cmd} | tee {log}`; `dklogs:31-32` appends `| less`.
- `argus:107-170` re-fetches in a `while:` loop instead of tailing.

The review states its own blind spot here: the corpus only contains what Rad could already express, so tools that needed streaming were never written in Rad at all. `kwatch` is the one observed instance of the migration away. Treat the evidence as a floor, not a ceiling.
title: Add iterators and streaming
